messages:
elaine: Hey team — thinking of doing a 'Tropical Tapas & Trivia' night next Friday. Small bus shuttle back + late-night bites. Who's in? :tropical_drink: :trumpet:

mike: I'm in! Count me for trivia. Any cost?

elaine: Budget around $20-25 pp (Redwood covering snacks, we can collect for bus if needed). Start 7:30pm for food, trivia at 8:30. Bus leaves 12:30am.

rachel: love this. Can we do a veg option? I'm vegetarian.

tariq: vegetarian + gluten-free here. Also happy to help coordinate the bus.

sara: boooo I'm on call Friday but might sneak out. if I join, 9pm onwards.

jon: vote: themed team name? 'Cache Me If You Can' :joy:

elaine: haha yes. Also poll: reaction ✅ = coming, :maybe: = probably, ❌ = can't.

sam: ✅

jess: ✅ can't wait!

mike: ✅ for me too.

rachel: :maybe: need to check schedule.

elaine: cool — tally so far: 5 ✅, 1 :maybe:, 1 :maybe on call. Bus preference? pickup at office vs nearby Bart?

tariq: pickup at office works. I can drive if bus is expensive (I have a van).

sara: if bus + driver is $10 each I'll chip in.

elaine: great — I'll book venue (La Playa Tapas) and post final RSVP by Wed. If anyone has trivia categories they'd like (music, movies, random tech jokes), drop them below.

jon: music + 'bad startup names' round please.

sam: also add a 'weird holiday' lightning round.

elaine: notes: bring ID for bar, venue can do mocktails. rachel/tariq — noted for dietary. I'll DM logistics to attendees. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Reminder — please fill out the event waiver here: https://forms.gle/example (company policy).

jess: RSVP submitted! :thumbsup:

mike: Can we do a photo booth?

elaine: I'll ask venue. Ok I'm going to lock the booking if no objections by 48h. Thanks everyone!
